factual_averments.description: Chronological list of substantive facts. MUST NOT contain reliefs, prayer requests, or paragraph numbers.

cause_of_action.description: When and where the cause of action arose (e.g., dates of threats).

jurisdiction.description: Facts establishing the territorial and pecuniary jurisdiction of the court.

valuation_and_court_fee.description: Valuation of the suit and court fee details. Leave blank if not provided.

prayer.description: The specific reliefs requested by the plaintiff. MUST NOT be mixed into factual_averments.
